title: great app
body: the best habit tracking app, the fact it’s one time purchase instead of an overpriced weekly subscription makes it worth every penny, app is clean and actually encourages and helps you complete the habits, however i wish there were more customisation options

title: Awesome awesome awesome
body: Idea of keeping a streak forces you to complete your tasks. You can add multiple tasks like offering salah, reciting holy Quran, doing exercises or drinking water in different categories. You can add widgets which either gives you sense of accomplishment or temptation to complete the task you had added. Awesome app, awesome design. Bravo
